status: DRAFTED before any projected-residual model exists; REGISTERED (frozen, its sha256 bound into the grant) only on the maintainer's approval, and never amended after the first PW-Augmented result exists

arms.PW-Augmented: NEW: the 900M projected-residual student (design.json :: architecture, initialization), trained exactly as D4-Augmented with the projections trainable (design.json :: recovery), two seeds
arms.D4-Augmented: REUSED: H1-PA's two D4-Augmented units; not retrained, not re-evaluated
arms.PCA-Original: REUSED: H1-PA's two re-evaluated E1 checkpoints; descriptive only

isolated_variable: the student architecture and its initialization: full-width residual stream with per-layer trainable PCA projections, against D4 Top-1's global 1,024-wide PCA residual. Selections (layers, heads, neurons), teacher, data, recipe, seeds and evaluation are D4-Augmented's

inside_the_variable._: these change together and P is never read as any one of them
inside_the_variable.compute: 1.18x the training FLOPs per supervised position with the teacher's forward (1.42x student-only); 1.49x the inference FLOPs at context 4,096
inside_the_variable.width_reduction: 28 trainable per-layer bases vs one fixed global basis
inside_the_variable.basis_statistic: the two normalized sub-layer inputs at each layer, unweighted over every real token, vs the forward baseline's global residual second moments
inside_the_variable.output_head: the teacher's 2,560-wide tied head, frozen, vs D4's projected 1,024-wide tied head, frozen

seed_pairing: P pairs PW-Augmented and D4-Augmented by training-seed number; every directional label needs both seeds' own estimates on its side
multiplicity: P is the only decided comparison, at its own 95% interval; within it the four static-axis contrasts are a Holm family at alpha 0.05 (h1_statistics)

evaluation.route: the folded stock-Qwen3 form of each recovered checkpoint (design.json :: evaluation.route), admitted only under design.json :: evaluation.fold_acceptance

primary_measure: identical to the H1-PA / mixed-calibration primary measure: correctness on the 570 formal static items of fluid_reasoning_720 (dev_v1), one nucleus_v1 sample per item and seed, clustered by rule family; the 144 interactive episodes are exploratory

labels.GO: the interval lies wholly above +5 pp and both seeds' estimates are above +5 pp
labels.NO_GO: the interval and both seeds' estimates lie inside (-5, +5) pp and neither arm is below 2%
labels.REVERSED: the interval lies wholly below -5 pp and both seeds' estimates are below -5 pp
labels.NOT_RESOLVED: both arms below 2% (flag FLOOR); one arm below 2% is flagged FLOOR_<arm> beside the label

decision_rule.same_rule_as: the H1-PA and mixed-calibration decisions (constants identical except the new bootstrap seed)

reachable_labels: D4-Augmented is at 4.56% pooled static correctness, so REVERSED cannot occur on the pooled contrast and GO needs PW-Augmented near 11% or above; deduction (13.5%, SESOI 8 pp) can reach every label. The study is powered to exclude or detect a 5 pp pooled difference, not a small one

advancement_to_600m._: the maintainer decides after reviewing the complete result; nothing here starts any 600M work automatically (brief 3.3)
expected_for_recommending_600m: P labelled GO, or deduction labelled GO and surviving Holm with the pooled label not REVERSED
training evidence: both seeds' runs complete without divergence, their final validation KD at or below D4-Augmented's at the same step, and the projections' orthogonality drift reported
guard_rails: protocol integrity: natural termination over the 996 capability and legacy replies not more than 10 points below D4-Augmented's for either seed
no eval-set-1 unit's correctness more than 10 points below D4-Augmented's mean on both seeds
the fold check passed for both checkpoints
advancement_to_600m.if_NO_GO: a meaningful gain is excluded at 1.5x the parameters and 1.18x the training compute; recommend not funding 600M on this evidence
advancement_to_600m.if_INCONCLUSIVE_or_NOT_RESOLVED: no recommendation either way; the reasoning difficulty ladder (docs/shared/REASONING_DIFFICULTY_LADDER.md), if registered, is the instrument that can resolve below the floor

reported_beside: each static axis per arm and seed, unseen rule and unseen format tiers
every eval-set-1 unit, correct AND usable side by side over its formal items (the h1pa_fullset layout)
protocol integrity: natural termination, degeneration stops, context-limit hits
generation lengths (reasoning and answer tokens) per unit
training: loss curves, validation CE/KD at every eval step, step-0 KD (diagnostic only)
per-layer projection orthogonality and singular values at step 0 and at the end
parameters, training FLOPs, inference FLOPs, KV cache, measured training step time and peak memory, measured evaluation throughput (design.json :: not_matched)
never: retraining D4-Augmented or regenerating its evaluation
changing this rule, its constants, the evaluation set, the mask, the scorers or the decoding protocol after a PW-Augmented result is seen
a pooled score across units, or usable rollout, KL, loss or PCA energy read as reasoning
selecting, dropping or re-running a seed for its result
claiming a same-size advantage: neither parameters nor FLOPs are matched
starting any 600M work, or any other search or recovery, automatically from a result of this study
